title: कर्ण ने अपना कवच क्यों दान कर दिया?
source: Mahabharata, Vana Parva (public-domain epic; this retelling is our own)

shots.motion: Anime style. A tall Indian warrior in a radiant golden breastplate stands still on a riverbank at sunrise. His hair moves gently in the breeze and the armour glints. Very slow camera push-in. Consistent face, smooth natural motion.
shots.line: कर्ण सोने के कवच और कुंडल के साथ जन्मे थे।

shots.motion: Anime style. An Indian warrior stands in a calm river at dawn with raised hands, water trickling from his palms toward the rising sun. Ripples spread slowly. The camera holds still. Consistent face, smooth natural motion.
shots.line: हर सुबह सूर्य पूजा के बाद वे हर माँगने वाले को दान देते थे।

shots.line: वचन निभाने वाला ही सच्चा महान होता है।

caption: Karna jaanta tha ki maangne wala kaun hai, phir bhi usne mana nahin kiya.
